title: Match loudness across narration clips
statement: Measure each narration clip's loudness and match the clips across a lesson, since gain alone under a true-peak ceiling may not bring them close enough.
example: In one build, gain alone under a true-peak ceiling left the clips about 3 decibels apart.
detail: Real-browser QA of a narrated build measured its eight delivered clips at −18.2 to −21.3 LUFS after linear gain capped by a −1.5 dBTP true-peak ceiling, with no compression applied. The spread of about 3 dB passed with a note: acceptable for review, with a limiter needed for tighter matching. The handover lists inconsistent volume or timbre among the faults to check for in every clip.
against: The 3 dB bar was a review judgment, not an agreed target: "Exact mastering targets should be selected and documented for the delivery platform; they have not been agreed here." (g9-archive/handover-2026-10-06/Othello-handover-docs-and-transcript-2026-10-06.zip!/Othello-handover/Othello-project-handover.txt, line 323).

evidence.quote: delivery −18.2 to −21.3 LUFS (linear gain capped by −1.5 dBTP true-peak ceiling; no compression applied). Within ~3 dB; acceptable for review, a limiter would be needed for tighter matching
Narration: gemini-2.5-pro-preview-tts, voice Orus, eight AAC-LC .m4a clips, 260.2 s total.

Check for dropped words, added commentary, misread names, odd emphasis, unintended character voices, truncation, duplicate passages, long accidental silences, distortion, and inconsistent volume or timbre.
